Color identity: GW | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 1 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite landfall triggers; Return all nonland permanents from your graveyard to the battlefield
Start: Emeria Shepherd (battlefield); Aftermath Analyst (battlefield); Tiller Engine (battlefield); Trenching Steed (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
  You control a Plains.
Steps: Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
  Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
  Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
  Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
  When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd and Tiller Engine trigger that many times.
  Resolve all Tiller Engine triggers, untapping each land that entered.
  Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
  Repeat.
Notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

Color identity: GW | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 17 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {3}{W}
Produces: Infinite creature tokens; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite storm count; Infinite blinking of nonland permanents; Infinite magecraft triggers; Return all creature cards with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield; Return all artifact cards with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield
Start: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward (battlefield); Against All Odds (hand); Timeless Witness (exile: exiled by Abdel Adrian)
Prerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Against All Odds exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Steps: Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
  Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Timeless Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
  Abdel Adrian and Timeless Witness trigger.
  Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
  Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Against All Odds.
  Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Timeless Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
  Repeat.

Cards: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward + Yannik, Scavenging Sentinel + Restoration Angel
Color identity: GW | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 420 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
Produces: Infinite creature tokens; Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite blinking of nonland permanents
Start: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward (hand); Yannik, Scavenging Sentinel (battlefield); Restoration Angel (exile)
Prerequisites: Restoration Angel exiled by Yannik
Steps: Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
  When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Yannik and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
  When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Restoration Angel returns from exile to the battlefield.
  When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
  Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Yannik to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Yannik and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
  Resolve the Yannik trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Yannik leaves the battlefield.
  Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Yannik and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
  Repeat from step 3.

## Combo 372-1734-1916
Cards: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward + Fiend Hunter + Changeling Titan
Color identity: GW | Bracket: 3-4+ (Spicy) | Popularity: 25 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite creature tokens; Infinite blinking of nonland permanents; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB
Start: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Fiend Hunter (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Changeling Titan (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Changeling Titan must be exiled by Fiend Hunter, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
  When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
  When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
  When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
  When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Cards: Emeria Shepherd + Aftermath Analyst + Amulet of Vigor + Trenching Steed

Produces: Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite landfall triggers; Return all nonland permanents from your graveyard to the battlefield
Start: Emeria Shepherd (battlefield); Aftermath Analyst (battlefield); Amulet of Vigor (battlefield); Trenching Steed (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
  You control a Plains.
Steps: Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
  Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
  Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
  Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
  When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd and Amulet of Vigor trigger that many times.
  Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping each land that entered.
  Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
  Repeat.
Notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.
